title: Practice 10: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: It looks like you've gone out of the frying pan and into the fire.
exercises.why: Where to: в and на — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
